about: The advisory SonarQube scan's triage baseline (task-0250, doc-0033). Each entry accepts up to `count` issues of `rule` in `path`, with its reason; tools/quality/report.py lists them apart from the open issues, and a further issue of the same rule in the same file is open again. A finding a task will fix is not accepted here: it stays open until the fix lands (task-0246, task-0248, task-0249, task-0251). For one line, `# NOSONAR(<rule>) <why>` in the code does the same.
